spans.s:
mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Made, formed.
2 Fixed, appointed.
3 Ascertained, determined.
4 Cut, pared, shorn.
E.
कृप to be able, &c. affix क्ल, and the augment इट् omitted.

f. (-ला)
Title deed, lease of a house, &c.
E.
कॢप्त fixed, कील a bolt or pin.

m. (-पः)
Frankincense, olibanum.
E.
कॢप्त made, धूप incense.
